description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayLaunchAgentManager, specifically testing the parsing of launch agent plist files to extract configuration parameters such as port, bind address, token, and password. It verifies the behavior when all parameters are present and when optional parameters are missing.

methods.name: launch agent plist snapshot parses args and env
methods.description: Test method that verifies parsing of a plist with full arguments and environment variables, checking that the snapshot correctly extracts port, bind address, token, and password.

methods.name: launch agent plist snapshot allows missing bind
methods.description: Test method that verifies behavior when the bind address is missing from the plist, ensuring the snapshot handles optional values correctly.
